about_the_game:
Deck out your heroines with new dresses, eyes, horns, and hairdos with the Another World Heroine Generator 6 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft continues their fantasy generator part series with 40 more MZ-style pieces to give your characters a makeover. 5 Beast Ears, 20 Clothing, 5 Eyes, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair generator parts are ready to turn your generic female NPCs into vibrant and exciting characters!

Want to give your villains a new look? Then grab this pack’s 5 horns to add a monstrous detail to them, with sharp angled ones and curving sheep’s horns so you can pick the ones that perfectly fit your villainess. If you’ve been wanting to fill a hospital with unique nurses or need some more demonic lady knights to join your party, pick up the Another World Heroine Generator 6 for MZ pack!


Contents:

・5 Beast Ears
・20 Clothing
・Eyes: 5
・Front Hair: 5
・Rear Hair: 5

＊An optimized base body is included in each folder in this pack, so please save the default base body in a separate local folder, and then store the optimized base body in each generator folder for use.


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
